title: データベースマネジメント
subtitle: Database Management
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) acquire the basic ability to utilize IT. (2) learn the fundamental theory of relational databases. (3) learn how to design a database, use SQL, and operate a database.
advice: To use a database, the following three abilities are required: 1. The ability to use SQL, a language for managing data held in a database. 2. The ability to maintain data integrity using normalization, primary/foreign key, and so on. 3. The ability to design application systems using a database. Students will acquire abilities 1 and 2 mainly through lectures and exercises in the first half of the course; they will acquire ability 3 in the second half of the course.
books: マンガでわかるデータベース(Japanese book)
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of computers such as the basic operation of a PC, Web design, IT systems, etc.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain what a database is.
Be able to explain a relational database.
Be able to design an E-R diagram.
Be able to convert an entity to third normal form.
Be able to use the SQL’s “SELECT” statement.
Be able to design a database.
